note: Each sign gets one pick. The pick is matched by sq (Square item id); name is for reference. Dates are month/day in Toronto time.

signs.name: Papilefiko Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Papilefiko takes its name from the Esperanto for “butterfly effect”: the idea that small, steady actions add up to something enormous. That is the Capricorn way of building a life. Its base of balsam fir and moss belongs to Saturn, your ruling planet and the old keeper of evergreens, while cardamom and lavender keep it crisp and composed. Wear it on the days you do the unglamorous work that pays off later.

signs.name: Replica Jazz Club
signs.why: Jazz Club was inspired by a night in a Brooklyn jazz club, the kind of room where nobody plays a song the same way twice. That is home turf for Aquarius, the sign of originals and good company. The rum and tobacco leaf suit the water-bearer, forever pouring for everyone at the table, and vanilla and smoky styrax keep you warm through the coldest weeks of February.

signs.name: La Melodie Maximal Parfum
signs.why: Claude Marsal names every fragrance after music, and La Mélodie is made for Pisces, the sign most likely to have a soundtrack running in its head. Sea notes and grapefruit drift in like a tide, ambergris adds the soft salt of the ocean your sign has always belonged to, and jasmine and a pour of whisky give it a romantic, late-night depth. It is a daydream you can wear.

signs.name: Zoltan Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Zoltán is a Hungarian name that traces back to “sultan,” a ruler, which feels right for the sign that leads the zodiac. Aries is ruled by Mars, the planet astrologers gave every hot, fiery spice, and Zoltan answers with a heart of cinnamon and red rose. Its icy mint and grapefruit opening fits a season that begins as winter breaks, and leather and amber carry all that confidence through the day.

signs.name: Wulong Cha Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Taurus is ruled by Venus, and three of the planet's classic notes run through Wulong Cha: sweet orange, fig and soft musk. They wrap around oolong tea, whose Chinese name means “black dragon,” a fitting nod to the steady earth sign that refuses to be rushed. It is a scent for long lunches, slow Sunday mornings and every small pleasure you make time for.

signs.name: Hacivat Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Gemini loves a good conversation, and Hacivat takes its name from the silver-tongued half of Turkey's famous shadow-puppet duo. Pineapple, grapefruit and bergamot open bright and quick, then cedar, patchouli and oakmoss give it a dry, grounded finish. It has two moods in one bottle, which suits you perfectly, and it moves easily from a June patio to a late dinner.

signs.name: Le Piano Eau de Parfum
signs.why: Claude Marsal describes Le Piano as a scent made by the ocean and the sun, which is about as close as a fragrance gets to Cancer's natural habitat. Your sign is ruled by the Moon, keeper of the tides, and sea notes and Calone give this one a cool, watery heart. Citrus, freesia and soft white musk keep it gentle and familiar, like the old piano at the cottage that everyone gathers around.

signs.name: Tempfluo Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Leo is ruled by the Sun, and Tempfluo is full of the notes astrologers have long given it: saffron, mandarin and orange blossom, settling onto cedar and cashmere wood. Its name means “time flow” in Esperanto, and Nishane built it around one idea, make the most of right now, which may be the most Leo philosophy there is. Bright, golden and generous, it was made for your moment in the sun.

signs.name: Uomo (2021)
signs.why: Virgo is the zodiac's craftsperson, and Valentino Uomo comes from a Roman couture house built on the same devotion to detail. Its heart is iris, an ingredient perfumers prize for its patience, since the root is aged for years before it gives up its powdery scent. Lemon and bergamot keep it clean, earthy vetiver grounds it in your earth element, and cardamom and black pepper give it a sharp, tailored finish.

signs.name: Ani Extrait de Parfum
signs.why: Libra is ruled by Venus, and Ani is built on the notes astrologers have long tied to that planet: rose, vanilla, benzoin and sandalwood. Sharp ginger and bergamot keep them in check, so it never tips too sweet or too fresh. It moves from a Saturday brunch to a late dinner with the easy charm your sign is known for.

signs.name: Noir Eau de Parfum
signs.why: Tom Ford built Noir around the two sides of a man: the polished one everyone meets, and the private, sensual one very few get to know. No sign understands that better than Scorpio. Pink pepper, black pepper and nutmeg carry the heat of Mars, your traditional ruler, while iris, rose and a warm, animal base of leather and amber reveal themselves slowly, the way you do.

signs.name: Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum
signs.why: Saffron, the spice old astrologers filed under Jupiter, is the first thing you notice in Tuscan Leather, and it suits a sign ruled by the planet of luck and big horizons. The name nods to Tuscany's leather-working tradition, and the scent smells like a well-travelled bag: bright raspberry and saffron, then supple leather, olibanum and amber that soften over the day. Generous, bold and ready for wherever you are headed next.
